text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho,
is usually held at Nakayama Racecourse.
However, due to the earthquake this year—

It was held at Tokyo Racecourse.
A month had passed since then, and everyday life
was gradually returning to normal, but...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I came here for now, but...
...Is this really okay?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
On my way here, there was a road that had liquefied...
If things are like this even over here, the disaster area must still be...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
And yet, trying to have fun...
I guess that was a bad idea after all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Orfe-san.
You're a king, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Show it to me.
—That light.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
............Ah, dammit,
I'm not in the mood to sing.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I wonder if "Orfevre"
is just gonna disband like this...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
...Not like I've got anything else to do.
Guess I'll... watch the race.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
"...Why is it that she's
able to run—?"
The confusion about running a race in the current situation was spreading among the competing Umamusume as well.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"A Classic race...
It was my dream, but..."

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't focus on training.
I wonder if I'll really be able to deliver results...
choice_data_list: (I know how it feels to waver, but—)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —How unpleasant.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I said it is displeasing.
Those who will not challenge, begone.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
To stand alongside Me while burdened with doubt...
Know shame.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What is that supposed to mean...!
Look at the situation we're in! It can't be helped—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Silence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
If you intend to enter the gate,
then at the very least...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Entertain me.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, so annoying...!
I definitely won't lose to you...!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...I've just... got to do it, right...?
Because the race is about to start...!
"Yes, the race is about to begin. I want every single Umamusume to give it her all in this once-in-a-lifetime Classic race. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
Seems your fighting spirit's grown a bit.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Will you serve as an embellishment to my victory...?
Let us see.
choice_data_list: ...Orfe, people's opinions of you are divided.

text_block_list.text: Due to Orfevre's whimsical and domineering nature, some racing fans rate her poorly, calling her unstable. However...

Throughout the Junior Class, all concerns were eliminated.
Stronger, faster... more solid than ever.
She had attained the power worthy of her vessel.
choice_data_list: There's nothing wrong with you as you are now!
There's nothing wrong with you as you are now!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Goes without saying.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Still, what a lucky man.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Still, what a lucky woman.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You may burn the trail of my light
into your eyes up close.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Soon, it will "begin."
—Sing out proudly.

As I watch Orfevre leave,
I touch the gold filigree pendant on my chest.

Well well, Happy New Year.
—And this... belongs to you.
It was a beautiful gold filigree ornament entrusted to me by a certain Umamusume this New Year's... Strangely captivated by it, I started wearing it.

—I clasp my hands tight. Praying that Orfevre's one and only
Classic campaign...
will be filled with joy and adoration.

Into people's hearts, even if just a little... just a single spoonful.
Wishing for hope to shine like gold dust—

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Hey dear, aren't you watching the races today?
Isn't that 'G-One'... or whatever it's called, happening today?

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm just not in the mood.
I'll pass for now."

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Geez... moping like that. Let's see,
what channel was the race on again...
Wait, oh?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: What a beautiful girl...
